purpose: Separate same-state observable sharing from work across distinct QML inputs and parameter bindings.

hardware_efficient_local.description: Data-encoded RY layers with alternating nearest-neighbor CX brickwork.

qcnn_like_local.description: Local convolution and pooling-style CX blocks; a controlled QML-inspired circuit, not a canonical QCNN implementation.

data_reuploading.description: Repeated data RX encoding, trainable RY rotations, and alternating nearest-neighbor entanglers.

same_state_local_outputs.description: One concrete prepared state; local Z outputs over all wires.

same_state_shared_cone.description: One prepared state; distinct X/Y/Z observables on one wire share the same causal cone.

different_examples.description: Four distinct data encodings with shared topology; no state-evolution reuse across examples.

parameter_shift_pair.description: Plus/minus pi/2 changes at the same single RY occurrence; separate evolved states, shared structural shape.

parameter_trajectory.description: Four concrete trainable-angle points with identical topology; structural reuse only, not state reuse.

comparison.timing_scope: plan plus collect after deterministic workload construction; planning and collection also recorded separately

parallel_probe.pool_scope: one warmed process pool per worker count, reused for all cases in the probe
parallel_probe.comparison_scope: fixed execution graph; planning is measured separately and not included in collection timing

exhaustive_oracle.description: Enumerate every set partition of five same-state observables; each block executes the conservative causal cone of the union support, and include an explicit full-state candidate.
exhaustive_oracle.scope: finite no-cut grouping portfolio; not a global simulator optimum

replay_probe.planner: auto strategy, joint bounded grouping, no cuts, no rewrite
replay_probe.accounting: template creation and its seed collection are charged once; each later point compares fresh plan+collect with replay plan+collect

large_cone_probe.description: Scale the highest-overlap shared-observable-cone case to 20 qubits; retain data-reuploading as a cone-saturation control.
large_cone_probe.validation: matrix-free NumPy statevector oracle; absolute tolerance 1e-10

ionq_noisy_probe.description: Noisy full/separate/grouped measurement-basis jobs for the same-state XYZ cone-sharing workload; data re-uploading is the cone-saturation control.
ionq_noisy_probe.note: Each noncommuting Pauli is measured in its own basis; cloud/API wall time is not QPU queue or hardware execution time.

analysis_split: Offsets 0 and 101 are development instances; offsets 202 and 303 are held-out instances. Repetitions estimate within-case timing variability only.
